text:
Rina: Heads up: observed recurring 80-150ms stalls during mixed-context chats, looks like host-prefetch handoff. Pattern: tokens stream -> pause -> catch-up.
Omar: Any traces? is it host alloc latency or NVMe/page-in?
Rina: Snippet: 
```
[2026-03-26T02:14:27.001Z] runtime: req=0x3b stage=ATTN
[2026-03-26T02:14:27.045Z] offload: demote kv tenant=acme
[2026-03-26T02:14:27.046Z] pool: host_acquire blocking
[2026-03-26T02:14:27.170Z] pool: host_acquire returned 124ms
[2026-03-26T02:14:27.172Z] runtime: resumed
```
Jules: Blocking acquire in-hot-path is root cause. We assumed host_acquire cheap; reality: VM lazy commit + NUMA + occasional NVMe sync.
Marta: Short-term fix: increase demote_cooldown to reduce churn and add a tiny backoff jitter to avoid synchronized demotes across requests.
Omar: Medium-term: non-blocking acquire that returns {ok,pending,fail}. If pending, runtime treats as cache-miss and recomputes context or routes to fallback.
Rina: We need limits: pending leases must be capped per-tenant and per-node, otherwise memory explodes. Suggest default pending_bytes_per_node=64MB.
Jules: Lease design notes: Lease {id, tenant, bytes, state}, state transitions: created->pending->ready|cancelled. Background offloader dequeues copy tasks and marks ready. Runtime can wait_ready(timeout) or proceed as miss.
Marta: Important crash semantics: on process restart, leases in host should be reconciled; either resume copy (if offloader checkpointed) or cancel and free. Add short-lived lease tombstones for recovery.
Omar: Telemetry: emit handoff_attempted, handoff_block_ms, lease_pending_bytes, lease_ready_ms, fallback_invoked. Also per-route fallback_count.
Rina: For POC: implement non-blocking acquire + recompute-on-pending toggleable config offload.mode={blocking,nonblocking,recompute}. I'll test with loadgen: `tools/loadgen --seq 1024 --batch 2 --qps 60 --demote-rate 0.25`.
Jules: I'll draft RFC with API sketch, GC policy (auto-cancel after 20s), caps, and fairness (round-robin offload queue per-tenant). Include unit/chaos tests for slow host allocs.
Marta: Canary plan: enable nonblocking+recompute on 3 canaries, demote_cooldown=400ms, pending_cap=48MB. Add alert if lease_pending_bytes > 75% cap.
infra-bot: deploy requested tag=offload-nonblocking-2026-03-26 target=canary-3
infra-bot: deploy finished: success on canary-3
Rina: Canary run shows P99 reduced ~60% and few fallbacks triggered. Node memory climbed slightly on canary-3; lowering cap to 40MB recommended.
Omar: I'll own the POC PR and add host-alloc latency histogram. Jules: you'll own RFC. Marta: tune canary and alerts. Follow up in 48h.
